reviews.title: Pure disappointment
reviews.text:
I’ve been using the app for years and honestly it’s becoming so sad. I was okay with getting ads (I get it you gotta survive), although showing them full blast during classes/work is definitely not something you thought about. Maybe you could show adds with no sound? 
It became quite annoying when you added ai button that cannot be removed from the screen unless you go to settings, plus adds started appearing even more often. 
But today it turned out I can’t add more notes. You call that “freedom of notes”? Moreover, if I delete old notes, I can’t add new ones instead of them. You call it Freenotes and then have to keep explaining in the reviews what it means? Probably misunderstanding from everyone and definitely not a marketing mistake, right. 
I looked through responses to reviews and it seems like you’re having financial difficulties with the app. That’s unfortunate and I hope it all will get better for you but it probably can be solved by deleting unnecessary content from the app (ai for example :) I used to recommend the app to all of my classmates, not anymore I guess.

reviews.title: disappointing.
reviews.text:
For the past few years I have been using Freenotes as an amazing app to take notes and organise my schoolwork. Not anymore. 

The recent updates have caused “Free”notes to no longer live up to its name. What was once a free, very well made app with great accessible features and tools is now a limited scam filled with AI slop. A note-taking app with a limited amount of notes you can create. 

Back when the app was still true to its name, I recommended it to a couple of friends. Now, I will be warning people about its downfall. I am truly disappointed with what Freenotes has become. I will be switching to different app to pursue my note-taking freedom. Farewell.

reviews.title: Absolutely Disappointed
reviews.text:
I have been using this app for four years and I absolutely loved it. In the time I have been using this app, I’ve been through its many updates and changes. At one point I even thought maybe I should try Goodnotes since it is so popular, but I did not particularly enjoy it and very much preferred “Freenotes”. That being said its title is very misleading. When they introduced ads I thought okay fine I understand it is hard to maintain a free app. Then they introduced AI and it was not my favorite; I am tired of everything including AI. But now I am opening this app and I can’t even create a new notebook without paying. Everything I have created is in this app and now I can’t even use it?? I don’t have anything else to say except I am extremely disappointed and you are better off finding a different note taking app. Now I have go through the process of finding a new app and a way to transfer everything! I never write reviews but this was the most frustrated I have ever been with an app. I understand it is hard for an app to stay free, but the beauty of “Freenotes” was that it was a simple app to just take notes. We did not need all this AI stuff or other clutter. 

Also after reading other reviews. I am even more disappointed. Saying that the free in “Freenotes” stands for freedom is such B.S. What a cop out statement! :(

reviews.title: Competent, but heavily monetized.
reviews.text: The drawing portion seems reasonably well executed, but it feels excessively monetized.  You know all those templates all those other note-taking apps provide?  Here, you get ruled, blank, and grid, and if you want anything else, you're going to have to pay for it or make your own.  There's a notion of "stationery," in a marketplace section with most prices ranging from $4-13.  You buy a notebook with a specific color scheme and design, you get a certain amount of templates with it, near as I can tell.  Get tired of the appearance?  Buy a new one.  Want a different form?  Buy another stationery.  There's a hundred forms in this package!  What do they look like?  Here's a tiny thumbnail of four.  What do the rest look like?  None of your business.  I've never regretted purchasing a lifetime license so quickly.  I feel gulled.

reviews.title: freenotes is no longer living up to their name💔
reviews.text:
this is officially the downfall of your app , a few months ago i had been using freenotes as it was convenient and efficient rather than using pen and paper. The app was great but up until this past month they have changed the feature which brought every one of us to downloading this app , the fact that it was FREE. Us STUDENTS cant pay for an app to simply study. Why call it freenotes if you had the plan to get us hooked ,then switch to subscription?? I think this is where your app goes downhill and unless there is no further change , don’t expect to be on the rise.

When i first heard of freenotes i decided to give it a go , and sooner or later it was my new form of taking notes. The format of the app was good, it was organised and i had no complaints whatever , it had cool features and the ability to export your notes into pdfs and whatnot , THERE WAS NOT A PROBLEM UNTIL U DECIDED TO DO THIS!! CHANGE.

reviews.title: Stole my money

I thought this app was great, so great that I actually paid £10 to remove ads like a month ago. HOWEVER, a recent update has changed to a subscription model to remove ads instead of a one time purchase and now I’m back to seeing ads even though I’ve already paid to remove them.

If I get my money back I’ll delete this review, until then I would recommend people do not use this scam of an app.

reviews.title: Incompatible with iPhone 16
reviews.text:
At least it is, on the free version of the app. I was trying to decide whether or not to pay for this app, and I tried to use the AI assistant.

If you are disabled, steer clear of this app. You will not have the support that you need and will need to pay for the app in order to find out whether or not it meets your needs. That's way too much time for me to spend on an app that holds out its hand for money before I can even make the first note.

My problem is that I cannot type, and I need to use voice control. My problems began on the first sentence. The app won't type accurately using dictation. What it does is to print the first word of the sentence or phrase that I dictate and then split that first word in half and insert the rest of the sentence or the phrase in the middle of the first word. This doesn't happen with the AI assistant chat box, and I've encountered these issues all over the Internet since I lost the ability to type for long periods of time.

The AI assistant directed me to support at Apple and support at freenotes. It couldn't look up a simple error and tell me whether or not the basic input methods for my very common device are compatible with their notes taking app. In order to continue to find this information out my choices are to pay for the app and hope that the AI assist is better in the pro version, or spend a while on the Internet trying to compare my software and theirs.

reviews.title: Why just why
reviews.text: I don’t know why you have done this to me. You’ve decided to make it have a limit to how much I can import and that’s seriously unethical and unprofessional I’m fuming. I need this for my future and you’ve stripped away all my abilities to do well in life, I don’t know why you have done this, you were my holy grail and I have recommended you to my good friends because I had loved you so much. Not anymore. I now have 2 more imports until I can’t anymore, how could you do this to a loyal user. I feel ashamed, hurt and most of all disappointed. Worst of all, you’ve turned to the dark side, using AI. I’m seriously losing all my hope for humanity. Hope you’re proud of yourselves. ;-;
